title: Cambridge IGCSE First Language English 0500/0990 — Paper 2 Directed Writing and Composition

authority.why_this_source: The syllabus states every tariff explicitly and covers the era our candidates sit. A June 2024 Paper 2 mark scheme IS on disk ('Sophicly Etch Mark Scheme Resources/CAIE GCSE English Language/CAIE English Language Paper 2/521329-june-2024-mark-scheme-paper-21.pdf') and should be added as a second authority when per-level descriptors are gated; for the TARIFFS the syllabus is the cleaner citation because it states them in words.
authority.do_not_use: 718839-2027-specimen-paper-2-mark-scheme.pdf — that is the 2027-2029 syllabus, a different paper.

protocols_note: Cambridge has NO protocol-a-assessment.md — it is served through topic templates (protocols/shared/templates/topics/cambridge-igcse-language-p2.md), which carry no 'Assessment Sub-Protocol: Question N' sections, so check E cannot read them. The chain is covered in two hops instead: this file proves BOARD PDF -> language-paper-specs.json (check D), and bin/cambridge-topics-gate.php runs the real SWML_Topic_Parser and proves TEMPLATE -> that same 80-mark spec. Do not add a protocols[] entry here expecting it to check the template; extend the Cambridge gate instead.
